item.title: Supercurrent enables the reading of quantum information without destroying it
item.description: One of the fundamental challenges of quantum computing is obtaining information from a quantum bit, or qubit. Unlike a conventional bit, which can be read repeatedly without altering its content, direct measurement of a quantum system typically causes the state to collapse before it can be determined. In other words, reading the information modifies it.

item.title: 中国量子计算可否跳出“追赶陷阱”？
item.description: 计算对于人类进步的重要性已毋庸置疑。凭借颠覆现有技术体系的巨大潜力，量子计算已成为备受瞩目的前沿科技之一，也是国际科技竞争的关键领域。

item.title: An algebraic characterisation of n-qubit pure-state invariants
item.description: arXiv:2610.36076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the set of $n$-qubit pure quantum states. Specifically, we consider their incarnation as density matrices in Bloch representation. Building on prior work, we define a family of quadratic functions in Pauli expectation values, and fully characterise all instances that result in state-independent purity constraints. item.title: Qubit-environment entanglement in pure dephasing dynamics for mixed initial states
item.description: arXiv:2610.36936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decoherence of qubits is one main limitation in quantum information processing, where the qubits themselves can be mixed because of decoherence and additional decoherence may generated through interactions with a bath.
